units: <cite ref="Menachot 35a:11">Men. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ מרובעות הלכה וכ׳</he> that the capsules of the T’fillin must be quadrangular is a Mosaic tradition; <cite ref="Megillah 24b:18">Meg. 24ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 6a:17">Ber. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>מנין שהקב״ה מניח ת׳</he> whence do you learn that the Lord puts T’fillin on? (Answ. ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 62:8">Is. LXII, 8</cite>) <he>ובזרוע עזו אלו ת׳</he> ‘and by his arm of strength’, that is the T’fillin; <he>ומנין שהת׳ עוז וכ׳</he> and whence do you learn that the T’fillin are ‘strength to Israel’? (Answ. ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 28:10">Deut. XXVIII, 10</cite>) <he>וראו … אלו ת׳ שבראש</he> ‘and all the peoples of the earth shall see that the name of the Lord is called upon thee, and fear thee’, this refers to the T’fillin on the head; a. v. fr.—Sing. <cite ref="V00831"><he>תְּפִלָּה</he></cite>, <cite ref="V00832"><he>תְּפִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 4:1">Men. IV, 1</cite> <he>ת׳ של יד אינה וכ׳</he> the T’fillah on the arm does not interfere with that on the head (v. <cite ref="P00712"><he>עָכַב</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:8">Meg. IV, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Megillah 24b:16">24ᵇ</cite>) <he>העושה תְּפִלָּתוֹ עגולה וכ׳</he> he who makes the capsule of his T’fillah round exposes himself to danger (v. comment.) without fulfilling the law.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 18:8">Kel. XVIII, 8</cite> <he>ת׳ ארבעה כלים</he> the T’fillah (of the head) is considered as consisting of four articles (with regard to levitical cleanness); a. e.
